title: Mixed Killing Vector Fields on Cigar Ricci-Bourguignon Solitons
summary: In this article, we study mixed Killing vector fields, defined by the condition $L_V L_V g = f\,L_V g$, on Cigar Ricci--Bourguignon solitons. While conformal vector fields are always mixed Killing, the converse fails in flat and open cylinders with base manifold geometries, where the mixed Killing class is infinite-dimensional. We establish a rigidity phenomenon for Cigar Ricci--Bourguignon solitons: any complete steady almost gradient Ricci--Bourguignon soliton on a surface with positive curvature is, up to homothety, Hamilton's Cigar soliton.
